_doc: Scenarios (fictional). map = map parameters; settings = game settings; goal.metric: bookValue | netWorth | bestYearRevenue | cargoLoads (with cargos) | rank (net-worth rank among all investors, lower is better). tiers = [bronze, silver, gold] thresholds. requires = conditions every medal needs (connect = your own track between two towns, by population rank). years = time limit from the start year; reaching gold earlier ends the scenario early. See BALANCING.md.

scenarios.name: Tutorial: First Spike
scenarios.brief: Learn the ropes: connect two towns, run a train and earn your first fortune. Step-by-step help guides you.

scenarios.name: The Iron Horse
scenarios.brief: 1835: the first railways are a curiosity. Build a profitable little line and grow the company's book value before 1845.

scenarios.name: Coal for the Mills
scenarios.brief: 1870: the steel mills are hungry. Haul coal, iron and steel — deliver as many loads as you can by 1880. One friendly rival competes for the towns.

scenarios.name: Bridge the Divide
scenarios.brief: 1880: the two largest towns lie far apart across rough country. Link them with your own track and make the railroad pay before 1892.

scenarios.name: Robber Barons
scenarios.brief: 1885: three ruthless barons want the country for themselves. Outplay them on the rails and on the stock market: be the richest by 1900.

scenarios.name: Streamliner Age
scenarios.brief: 1936: sleek diesels promise speed. Build a fast passenger network and reach the biggest net worth you can before 1950.
